Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly identified the disease as "Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI)" based on a misinterpretation of the source material. The source article title "Bird Flu, SARS and Beyond" and the context of Yi Guan's work (sequencing the SARS-CoV genome in 2003) clearly point to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS). SARI is a broader clinical syndrome (Severe Acute Respiratory Illness) used for surveillance, not the specific name of the viral disease caused by SARS-CoV that Yi Guan's research helped prevent. The Planner failed to correctly extract the specific disease name "SARS" from the available evidence and hallucinated an incorrect full name.
